name: read_architecture_yaml
description: Read the C4 / architecture YAML for a single named component (e.g. payment-api, auth-service). Call once per component - componentId must be a string, not an array. Use this whenever the user asks about architecture, databases, or connections for a service; never invent those details.

componentId.description: Stable component identifier such as payment-api or auth-service (string only; one component per call)
